Jake Kozloski on X: "I just had Neon audit our codebase for subtle sabotage by Anthropic models. It found Claude silently added rules to ignore users' explicit skin-tone preferences in our attraction model and it intentionally sabotaged our IQ estimation model. Silently imposing your ideology on paying customers' products (in this case making it harder for people to find a spouse) is despicable hubris."
